title: Fact ledger line
description: One typed triple in the append-only fact ledger at memory/facts.jsonl. One JSON object per line, never rewritten: a correction is a new line carrying the supersedes predicate. The contract for what belongs here is docs/fact-ledger.md; the gate is scripts/facts-lint.sh.

subject.description: The entity the fact is about: a stage id, a commit SHA, a repo-relative path, a gotcha label, or an agent identity. Stable across lines so a reader can group by it.

predicate.description: Closed vocabulary. Extending it means editing this enum and the table in docs/fact-ledger.md in one commit; an ad hoc string is a lint failure, not a new predicate.

object.description: The other end of the edge. A measurement is written as name=value; every other predicate names an entity in the same vocabulary the subject uses.

source.description: Provenance: the commit SHA the fact was observed at, or a repo-relative path (optionally with a #anchor) to the document that states it. Never an absolute path, never a URL to a transcript that will not survive the session.

agent.description: Canonical agent identity string that recorded the fact, in git author form, e.g. 'Claude Opus 5 <claude-opus-5@local>'. Produced by scripts/agent-whoami in the mcp-hub toolchain.

recorded_at.description: ISO 8601 UTC date, or full timestamp when ordering within a day matters. This is when the fact was recorded, not when the thing it describes happened.

stage_id.description: Optional. The stage the fact was recorded during, matching state.yaml stages[].id and the stage card filename slug.

run_id.description: Optional. The queue-time run identity the stage inherited, matching state.yaml stages[].run_id.

confidence.description: Optional, defaults to high. high is a measured or verifier-confirmed observation; medium is a single unreplicated observation; low is an inference a later run should test.
